hints.title: Subproblem Partition
hints.text: The number of decodings ending at index i depends on how many consecutive identical digits precede it.

hints.title: Key Length Constraints
hints.text: Digit keys '7' and '9' map to 4 characters, while all other digits map to 3 characters.

hints.title: Transition Formulation
hints.text: Add dp[i - k] for k from 1 up to max_len (3 or 4) as long as all k characters match pressedKeys[i - 1], applying modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: Linear Decoupled DP Implementation

complexity.notes: At each index at most 4 transitions are evaluated.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursive exploration of keypad decodings explores an exponential search tree.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Array of size n + 1 stores prefix decoding combinations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate checks digit-specific run length limits (3 vs 4) and applies modulo arithmetic correctly.
